prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Maryland?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single objectively “best” marketing agency for Maryland — the right one depends on your goals, industry, budget, and the services you need. I can help you find the best match. Quick questions to narrow it down:

- What service(s) do you need? (SEO, PPC, social media, branding, web design, PR, B2B demand gen, etc.)
- Are you a local small business, startup, or enterprise?
- Approximate monthly or project budget?
- Do you prefer an agency in Maryland (which city) or are remote/nearby (DC/Baltimore) OK?
- Any industries you want experience in (healthcare, legal, tech, hospitality, nonprofits)?

How I can help next:
- If you answer the questions above, I’ll compile a short list (3–6) of highly rated Maryland agencies matched to your needs, with strengths, estimated pricing, client examples, and recommended interview questions.
- Or, if you prefer, I can give general guidance now on how to evaluate agencies and a template email/RFP to send.

If you want a quick head start, tell me your primary service and budget and I’ll pull a tailored shortlist.
